metric_semantics.figure_5a: Exported val_loss. Klein/Torus used pixel-mean BCE; Euclidean 2D/3D/4D used pixel-summed MSE divided by batch size. This is not a comparable ELBO across models.
metric_semantics.figure_5b: One-sample empirical sum of coordinate variances on the fixed 500-point validation subset. Klein/Torus samples were wrapped with project_to_torus; Euclidean samples were unprojected.
metric_semantics.figure_6: L2 norm across H0/H1/H2 bottleneck distances between ambient persistence diagrams of 500 validation images and stochastic reconstructions.

configuration_notes.dataset_size: Figure data use 10,000 images; the proof experiment uses 100,000.
configuration_notes.batch_size: Figure data use batch size 512; the proof experiment uses 1,024.
configuration_notes.scheduler: Torus/Euclidean runs use factor 0.1 and patience 10.
